# Setup

To use quarto I would suggest using [VScode](https://code.visualstudio.com/) (You can "Disable Ai Features" in the settings).

To install Quarto see [The Quarto Get Started page](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/).

## Extensions

For this site you will also want to follow the below install instruction.

### R

[R in Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/languages/r)

### Spell checker

[Code Spell Checker](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=streetsidesoftware.code-spell-checker): Useful for spell checking normal words

When using this click on a misspelt word (signified by squiggly underlining) and press "ctrl+." to get a dropdown of suggestions

To change to GB spelling:

    1. Go to "Extension" on VScode (On far left, icon is three squares and a diamond)
    2. Click on the gear icon for Code Spell Checker
    3. Click on "Settings"
    4. Change "C Spell: Language" to "en-GB"
